Task 'palette-publish' completed successfully.

[1/2] Add an authored camera identity and unique palette to the AIKit brand catalog, regenerate the logo and social preview, capture a real 1440x900 screenshot, review all assets, and publish them in the project; [2/2] hand the approved media to the AegeanWorks dossier.

impact_assessment.why: The fallback terminal mark misrepresented an image editor and the generated preview truncated its tagline.
impact_assessment.benefits: A recognizable camera logo, a complete social preview and a real UI capture give the portfolio a trustworthy identity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: brand catalog count/uniqueness; dependency: Pillow for the dossier build; concurrency: none; state: the screenshot is commit-stamped.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Update the catalog count test, regenerate both assets, inspect them, and stamp the capture with the published commit.

Evidence: 78/78 tests, 4/4 gates, dogfood, media approvals, dossier check 0 problems; AIKit b15736b and site 3b50f84. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-media' completed successfully.

[1/4] Add clipToBelow to the layer model, serialize it in project/autosave format v2 with v1 migration and tests. [2/4] Render clipping through a shared compositor helper in the viewport, exports, flatten and merge-down. [3/4] Add the layer clipping control, row indicator, shortcut and browser dogfood coverage. [4/4] Bump Palette to 0.12.0, document it, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell.

impact_assessment.why: Clipping masks are the main Photoshop layer capability still missing; they let users confine a layer to the alpha of the layer below without destructive erasing.
impact_assessment.benefits: Non-destructive per-layer clipping, correct viewport and export compositing, persisted projects and autosave, one-step undo, and parity with the vendored site.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: project and autosave formats gain a field and version; dependency: Canvas 2D only; concurrency: AegeanWorks will vendor this tree; state: clipped layers must follow the nearest unclipped base and hide when it is hidden.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Read format versions before writing, migrate v1 records to clip=false, centralize stack compositing, keep merge inside a clipping group, and verify with unit, browser and site checks.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/4]-[4/4]: layers carry a persisted clipToBelow flag with project/autosave format v2 and v1 migration; a shared drawLayerStack composites clipped layers through the nearest unclipped base in the viewport, exports, flatten and merge-down; the Layers panel toggles clipping with Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+G, shows a clip badge, and refuses merges across a clipping-group boundary; Palette is 0.12.0 with 81 tests and browser dogfood for clipping pixels, state, undo and autosave restore. AegeanWorks vendors 0.12.0 at hash 430771616171b27a, records it in live.json, and bumps the shell to v39. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).
Task 'palette-clipping-masks' completed successfully.

[1/4] Add a Clone stamp paint helper and editor action that samples an Alt-clicked source from the active layer snapshot, paints through the brush mask and selection, and commits one undo step. [2/4] Add the clone tool rail button, options panel, S shortcut, brush-size shortcut and source/brush overlay markers with contract tests. [3/4] Add browser dogfood pixel and undo coverage, bump Palette to 0.13.0 and document the tool. [4/4] Re-vendor into AegeanWorks, bump the site shell and live catalogue, and run both gate suites.

impact_assessment.why: Clone stamp is the main retouching tool still missing; clipping and blend work made retouching the natural next layer.
impact_assessment.benefits: Local non-destructive retouching with one-step undo, selection-aware output, no new dependencies, and site parity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new tool and options surface; dependency: Canvas 2D only; concurrency: AegeanWorks vendors this tree; state: the source snapshot must not feed back into the stroke and the clone source must reset with a new document.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Snapshot the active layer before the stroke so cloning cannot feed back, clamp and refuse locked/hidden layers, clear the source on document replacement, and verify pixels plus undo in the browser.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/4]-[4/4]: a Clone stamp tool samples an Alt-clicked source from a pre-stroke snapshot of the active layer, paints through the brush mask and selection, and commits one undo step; the tool has its own size/hardness/opacity panel, S and bracket shortcuts, a source crosshair and brush ring. Palette is 0.13.0 with 82 tests and browser dogfood for source setting, copied pixels, untouched pixels and undo. AegeanWorks vendors 0.13.0 at hash 24974892d8434d9a, records it in live.json, and bumps the shell to v40. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).
Task 'palette-clone-stamp' completed successfully.

[1/4] Add a source-atop tone stroke helper and a Dodge/burn tool that lightens or darkens only existing layer pixels through the brush mask and selection. [2/4] Add the tool rail button, options panel with mode/size/hardness/strength, D shortcut and overlay ring with contract tests. [3/4] Add browser dogfood pixel and undo coverage, bump Palette to 0.14.0 and document the tool. [4/4] Re-vendor into AegeanWorks, bump the site shell and live catalogue, and run both gate suites.

impact_assessment.why: Retouching still lacks tonal tools; dodge and burn pair naturally with the clone stamp and cover the common local lighten/darken workflow.
impact_assessment.benefits: Local non-destructive tonal retouching with one-step undo, selection-aware output, no new dependencies, and site parity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new tool and options surface; dependency: Canvas 2D source-atop only; concurrency: AegeanWorks vendors this tree; state: tone strokes must not create pixels on transparent areas and must not accept locked or hidden layers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use source-atop compositing, clip to the selection, refuse locked/hidden layers, cap accumulated strength, and verify lighten, darken, untouched alpha and undo in the browser.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/4]-[4/4]: a Dodge & burn tool uses a source-atop tone stroke so only existing layer pixels lighten or darken, respects the brush mask and selection, leaves transparent areas untouched, and commits one undo step; it has mode, size, hardness and strength controls, the D and bracket shortcuts, and a brush ring. Palette is 0.14.0 with 83 tests and browser dogfood for lighten, darken, alpha preservation and undo. AegeanWorks vendors 0.14.0 at hash ad3b76430d338eac, records it in live.json, and bumps the shell to v41. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).
Task 'palette-dodge-burn' completed successfully.

[1/3] Enforce base layer clipping invariants across document lifecycle. [2/3] Fix live Move tool translation for clipped layers and clipping bases in drawLayerStack. [3/3] Add comprehensive test coverage, run Phase 4 gates, and close UI contract.

impact_assessment.why: Clipped layers at index 0 become invisible and un-unclippable; live dragging of clipped layers shifts the mask instead of the content; tone/clone lacked unit tests.
impact_assessment.benefits: Base layer is guaranteed visible and unclipped across move/delete/load; live move drag accurately reflects committed results; full test verification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: layer 0 clipToBelow is always false; dependency: Canvas 2D only; concurrency: none; state: moving preview must not mutate layers directly.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reset clipToBelow on index 0 in document mutations and loaders, test moving/removing/loading layer 0, test canvas layer stack live translation.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: enforce base layer clipping invariants (clearing clipToBelow on layer 0 in document mutations, project loading, and autosave) and fix live move tool drag in drawLayerStack so clipped layers slide inside stationary base masks while base layer moves shift the mask; add unit tests across document, project, and autosave suites. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-clipping-fix' completed successfully.

[1/2] Route external clipboard image paste to addImageLayer when a document exists, and update clone tool overlay to follow active sampling offset during dragging. [2/2] Add test coverage for editor shortcuts and paste routing, verify UI contract, and pass Phase 4 gates.

impact_assessment.why: Pasting an image when a document is open discarded the document instead of adding a layer; clone crosshair was stationary during painting.
impact_assessment.benefits: Standard image editor pasting behavior; live feedback on exact clone sampling source; clean verification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no API changes; dependency: web standards clipboard only; concurrency: none; state: uncommitted files must pass checks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve openImageFile fallback when no document exists; verify with tests.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/2]-[2/2]: route external image paste to addImageLayer when document exists, live-track clone sampling offset in overlay during drag, and add unit test coverage. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'palette-clone-paste-enhancements' completed successfully.
